messages:
maria-cs: Heads up: Acme Analytics (acct: ACME-889) flagged — their service was blocked earlier today due to an overdue invoice and a retroactive VAT charge. Customer is disputing VAT + says PO required. Invoice: INV-2026-334. Card on file declined 3x. Need help unblocking or escalation path.

billing-bot: Payment failure detected for INV-2026-334: card_declined x3. Account auto-suspended per dunning policy v2.1. Visit https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-334 to retry payment.

jake-finance: Jumping in. I see a VAT adjustment from 2025-11 applied on 2026-03-02 — total due $12,450. PO not attached. Customer claims they submitted PO to procurement@redwood.ai on 2026-03-04. @maria-cs can you confirm PO? If PO accepted, we can pause collections.

maria-cs: I chatted with their billing contact, emma@acme.co — she says PO #PO-7789 was sent but vendor field mismatched (Redwood Inference vs Redwood Labs). They won't reissue until vendor name corrected. They asked for service not to be suspended while sorting.

olivia-support: :thinking_face: default policy is to suspend on 7d overdue, but we can grant a 72h temporary lift for 'PO in flight' exceptions with manager approval. @jake-finance need approval code or email.

jake-finance: I can approve temporary lift for 72h. Add note: 'PO pending vendor name correction.' I'll set account to 'collections_hold' not 'suspended' so existing tokens limited but API stays up. Maria, send me customer email consent.

maria-cs: Copied below the customer's confirmation: 'We confirm PO-7789 was sent and procurement will correct vendor name by EOD 3/6. Please restore service while we resolve.' — emma@acme.co

jake-finance: Got it. Restoring limited service now. Updating billing portal: setting hold flag. Also sending instructions to retry card or upload PO.

olivia-support: Steps I ran to restore: patched account via admin console -> Accounts > ACME-889 -> Billing > Set hold=true. Confirmed API keys returning 200 for generation endpoint. Logs: 
```
POST /v1/generate 200
latency 72ms
```
Customer should test.

maria-cs: Customer tested and confirms generation working. They asked about VAT retrocharge — they're disputing it and want it waived. @sahil-legal any input?

sahil-legal: VAT retrocharges follow local tax rules. We can't simply waive without documentation. Ask customer for purchase purpose, destination country VAT registration. We can negotiate payment schedule but not remove legitimate tax liabilities. Suggest: ask for PO correction first, then review VAT docs. cc @jake-finance.

jake-finance: Propose payment plan if they can't pay full VAT now: 30% now, rest over 60 days. Require signed agreement. If they accept, we'll clear suspension and mark account 'on plan'.

maria-cs: I'll send both options to customer. Also FYI they requested invoice PDF with line-by-line VAT explanation. Link: https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-334/download

billing-bot: Reminder: dunning notice #DN-778 posted 2026-03-05 09:05. Next automated suspension scheduled in 72h if no resolution.

emma-acme: Thanks team. We'll correct vendor name today and send signed PO. Can you confirm API access restored? Also requesting VAT breakdown.

maria-cs: Confirmed restored in limited mode. Sending VAT breakdown and payment plan options now. Will escalate if legal docs required.

jake-finance: :thumbsup: I'll draft the payment plan template and upload to shared drive: https://redwood.ai/drive/payment-plans/ACME-7789

olivia-support: Closing loop here — monitor for 72h and set reminder. If PO doesn't arrive, revert to full suspension. Setting calendar reminder @maria-cs @jake-finance.

maria-cs: Thanks all. I'll update thread when PO received or if customer signs plan.
